summary: A ./library directory next to a playbook is automatically added to the module path, keeping custom modules with playbooks.
questions: How do I use a custom module without installing it globally?
Where can I put local modules so my playbook finds them?

answer_card.title: Local modules in ./library
answer_card.answer_md: Put custom modules in a `library/` directory next to your playbook file. Ansible adds it to the module path automatically.
